exposure: Regular physical activity (any form of physical activity at least twice weekly throughout pregnancy)
cohort: The study included 190,331 singleton pregnancies from the Slovenian National Perinatal Information System between 2013 and 2022.
finding: Regular physical activity during pregnancy was associated with reduced odds of preterm birth, preeclampsia, gestational hypertension, pelvic girdle pain, SGA, LGA, low Apgar scores, and reduced insulin requirement in women with GDM.
mod_finding: No significant association was found between regular physical activity during pregnancy and cesarean delivery.
followup_time: 5 minutes (for Apgar scores); postpartum (for urinary incontinence, specific duration not mentioned)
